content: Ambäl bɔ̈ɔ̈l bà Nzam
Bàfan'pà wɛŋwɛŋ làmwɛy asànaa un'aŋ musi bwɛl, waa bàtɛn a mɛ naa: « Mbarà, kasi idwà a Nzam anà mɛsà a ibɔɔn, anà taŋ baar bàfàkömà kwo.
Wɛɛ, wɛy ukɔl nsà a ndwà a Nzam, twon an'si ya, ntɔn ya bàkyàpà akà baar mpa abà Ayudà. Ba bàsàndyäär bul in'kyɛɛl ngɔn an'kwem an'nà aŋiyweel.
Mɛ in'sàtɔm ambäl amɛ bɔ̈ɔ̈l, bàŋàbwaar mpiir, ba bàsàtà ngɔɔm ilä nsaab mwɛy nkam yweel an'kwem an'syaam.
Ambäl abà bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l bà in'te a ɔlive myeel anà minà myeel amyà myàfàmbar kusà a Mwol a mɛɛn.
Isàkal naa mbuur mwɛy akwen mukyer ba ube, mbaa laa itoo ya u mun aba, waa iwuul ayiiŋ aba. Inye, mbuur wanswà akwen mukyer ba ube, nde asàkwà abà.
Ba bye anà ikɔ̈b mudübà du, ntɔn mbul ukɔ̈ɔ̈n anɔ umpal bàtaa ba ngɔɔm. Ba sye bye anà ikɔ̈b musɔɔm an'dà màbulà an'kil anà mupà mɛɛn ntaaŋàmbar yà ifà ifà, taaŋ lanswà bàkwen ba.
Wɛɛ mpal bàsàmay ba mutà imbäl, ntsür awà kan'too kà un'baan akyer asànwaan anà ba. Wa asàwal iböŋ udu a ba anà akyer asadwa.
Ndom aba yàsàkal aŋàyäänà u balàbal a kölàköl là bul a kölàköl, alà bàfàbel Sɔdɔm anà Ngipiti unsà idiim, ikal bàbɛɛrà Mwol aba u kulunsi.
Baar a in'sɛŋ myanswà, mbil yanswà, ndaa yanswà anà nsi yanswà bàsaleerà ndom aba ilä itär a ndam anà bàsàpà anki mbwo naa badyee.
Baar a mɛɛn bàmusaŋ. Ba bàmukyɔm unsà un'sak anà bàmupɛɛl an'kab, ntɔn aŋangɔɔm abà bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l bàmɛɛy baar a mɛɛn nkwaaŋ mbɔɔn.
Wɛɛ, ungö a ilä itär a ndam, un'swey a mɔ̈ɔ̈ kàfü akà Nzam kabilà uboo a ba anà ba waa bàmbarà. Matɛɛr màwɛl baar bàleerà.
Ba bàwem ndaa mwɛy yàngwal u du yàmuswaŋ ba naa: « Làlär pà! » Ba waa bàlär du uboo a itööm, u mii a ayiiŋ aba.

Taaŋ nsil alan, mɛɛn màkyer ani. Itiir imwɛy uboo a itiir kwem kyà bul kyàkyer abwabà, baar nsaab nsambwaar bàkü unsà ntɛɛr a mɛɛn ayi. Baar bàsäl bàbü matɛɛr anà bàpɛ làkoo akà Nzam a du.
Mpay yàyweel yan'lyaaŋ. Wɛɛ làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ, yàtär yà tsütsü muyà.
Un'kyeey wànsambwaar kan'bɛɛrà mfuŋ
Apan, un'kyeey wànsambwaar kàbɛɛrà mfuŋ. Ndaa a ngwal mbɔɔn yàfü du, waa yàtɛɛnà naa: « Apanà imwol a mɛɛn kyà akà Mwol abi anà akà Klistɔ ande. Imwol aki isàlam ipepey! »
Andweer an'kwem mɔ̈ɔ̈l aŋinà abà bàbwaay udu a an'kir aba mà imwol kusà a Nzam, bàbü aŋàtsüüm, waa bàkömà Nzam
anà mutɛn naa:

content.text: « Mwol, Nzam a Ngwal Yanswà, ngye awà, anà kàkäl,
bi kàmakömà ntɔn ngye kàsyääl ngwal angye yàkölàköl
taaŋ a nsaŋ a akü lan'kwo,
taaŋ ayàfur ngye asyääl angye aŋangɔɔm
anà bàngye banswà bàfàkyey ikɔb angye,
anà taaŋ mudwa baar bàfàtay mɛɛn! »

content: Idwà a Nzam, u du, waa kyàdubà, un'böl a nkwà waa kàmɛnà kwo. Apan, indiir mbɔɔn byàkyer amɛnà: miŋyä, làso a ndaa, ipar, ntɛɛr a mɛɛn anà mbul a in'kul.
